items.title: 基于大语言模型的业务流程长尾变化应变方法
items.title_zh: 基于大语言模型的业务流程长尾变化应变方法
items.summary_zh: 业务流程应变是业务流程管理的重要任务,旨在通过调整流程模型和实例行为来响应不断变化的环境,从而提高其柔韧性并实现业务目标。建模时,残留不确定性导致的长尾变化无法避免,给传统的业务流程应变技术带来了挑战。目前针对长尾变化最有效的应变方法基于一种三方协作框架,即由负责感知长尾变化和提出应变策略的前端业务人员、负责提供服务接口和合规性要求的后端技术人员和管理层,以及辅助应变实施的工具系统共同协作来应对长尾变化,保障业务目标达成。然而,长尾变化在不同时空条件下的多样性、复杂性和应变的迫切性,极有可能超出前端业务人员在应变时对当前情境的理解能力、依据情境制定应变策略的专业水平,以及将应变策略采用领域专用语言有效表达的熟练程度。为弥补这一缺憾并进一步拓展上述框架,提出了一种基于大语言模型的业务流程长尾变化应变方法LLM-Adapt,充分利用大语言模型的泛化能力、强大的内容生成能力,以及嵌入的事件与对策

extra.description: 业务流程应变是业务流程管理的重要任务,旨在通过调整流程模型和实例行为来响应不断变化的环境,从而提高其柔韧性并实现业务目标。建模时,残留不确定性导致的长尾变化无法避免,给传统的业务流程应变技术带来了挑战。目前针对长尾变化最有效的应变方法基于一种三方协作框架,即由负责感知长尾变化和提出应变策略的前端业务人员、负责提供服务接口和合规性要求的后端技术人员和管理层,以及辅助应变实施的工具系统共同协作来应对长尾变化,保障业务目标达成。然而,长尾变化在不同时空条件下的多样性、复杂性和应变的迫切性,极有可能超出前端业务人员在应变时对当前情境的理解能力、依据情境制定应变策略的专业水平,以及将应变策略采用领域专用语言有效表达的熟练程度。为弥补这一缺憾并进一步拓展上述框架,提出了一种基于大语言模型的业务流程长尾变化应变方法LLM-Adapt,充分利用大语言模型的泛化能力、强大的内容生成能力,以及嵌入的事件与对策知识库,形成一种更高效、灵活的应变机制。首先,以基于长尾变化特征的提示词工程为媒介,使前端业务人员能够通过自然语言与大语言模型进行交互并获得应变方案。其次,结合后端管理层制定的业务基线目标约束对应变方案进行功能性约束验证,提出的SSDT-Lane算法基于流程结构相似性对应变方案进行筛选,消除了大语言模型在流程调整、业务和组织架构匹配等方面面临的幻觉风险。基于合成数据和真实开源数据集的典型案例分析实验显示,LLM-Adapt相比现有方法,在应变准确性、效率、适用性等方面都表现出显著优势。

items.title: Attribution-based diagnostics for single-cell foundation models
items.title_zh: 单细胞基础模型的基于归因的诊断
items.summary_zh: 单细胞 RNA 基础模型 (scFM) 越来越多地用于计算机模拟生物发现，但仅预测性能并不能揭示它们的决策是否依赖于具有生物学意义的信号或特定于模型的捷径。我们系统地研究了两个任务中下游预测的事后归因：使用预训练的 Cell2Sentence 和 scGPT 模型进行细胞类型注释，以及在受控环境中使用 scGPT+STATE 进行扰动预测。对于细胞注释，我们使用归因来评估预测是否依赖于已建立的标记基因，以及它们的相关性如何随模型架构、表达等级和周围的细胞环境而变化。对于扰动预测，我们在合成环境中将归因模式与已知的监管基本事实进行比较，以评估它们揭示的有关模型学习计算的信息。在这些任务中，归因揭示了生物特征的使用、上下文交互、不同输入途径的贡献、学习进度、与预测质量的关联以及标准绩效指标未完全捕获的潜在陷阱。利用完整和有限的监管知识进行的实验进一步表明，从归因中得出的结论在很大程度上取决于生

extra.description: Single-cell RNA foundation models (scFMs) are increasingly used for in-silico biological discovery, yet predictive performance alone does not reveal whether their decisions rely on biologically meaningful signals or model-specific shortcuts. We systematically investigate post-hoc attribution of downstream predictions across two tasks: cell-type annotation using pretrained Cell2Sentence and scGPT models, and perturbation prediction using scGPT+STATE in a controlled setting. For cell annotation, we use attribution to assess whether predictions rely on established marker genes and how their relevance varies with model architecture, expression rank, and the surrounding cellular context. For perturbation prediction, we compare attribution patterns with known regulatory ground-truth in a synthetic setting to assess what they reveal about the model's learned computations. Across these tasks, attribution reveals biological feature use, contextual interactions, contributions from different input pathways, learning progression, associations with prediction quality, and potential pitfalls that are not fully captured by standard performance metrics. Experiments with complete and limited regulatory knowledge further demonstrate that conclusions drawn from attribution depend strongly on the choice of biological reference, baseline, and null model. Together, these findings highlight the value of attribution as a flexible post-hoc diagnostic for understanding model behavior, identifying potential issues, and informing the development of scFMs.

items.title: HELICS: Biobank-scale Conditional Synthetic Genome Generation via Latent Flow Matching
items.title_zh: HELICS：通过潜在流匹配进行生物样本库规模的条件合成基因组生成
items.summary_zh: 个体水平基因型数据支撑遗传发现、疾病风险建模和治疗开发，然而许多关键场景仍数据有限，包括代表性不足的祖先群体、罕见或不平衡疾病队列以及受限访问的生物样本库。条件合成基因组生成将支持隐私感知的基准测试、模拟和数据增强，但需要学习数十万至数千万相关单核苷酸多态性（SNPs，即DNA变异位点）上的超高维离散分布。我们引入HELICS：通过潜在插值条件合成的高保真生成，一个无定相潜在流匹配框架，用于从生物样本库规模基因型数据进行全基因组SNP水平生成。HELICS用卷积自编码器对染色体进行标记化，将>600K SNPs缩减为4,096个连续潜在标记，并在拼接的多染色体潜在表示上训练参数化条件流匹配的transformer模型。在英国生物样本库超过417K基因组上训练，HELICS无需单倍型定相即可生成全基因组常见变异合成队列，并比现有基于单倍型的模拟器更忠实于真实基因型，包括外部评估中高等位基因频

extra.description: Individual-level genotype data underpin genetic discovery, disease-risk modeling, and therapeutic development, yet many critical settings remain data-limited, including underrepresented ancestries, rare or imbalanced disease cohorts, and restricted-access biobanks. Conditional synthetic genome generation would support privacy-aware benchmarking, simulation, and data augmentation, but requires learning an ultra-high-dimensional discrete distribution over hundreds of thousands to tens of millions of correlated single-nucleotide polymorphisms (SNPs), or sites of DNA variation. We introduce HELICS: High-fidelity gEneration via Latent Interpolant Conditional Synthesis, a phasing-free latent flow matching framework for genome-wide SNP-level generation from biobank-scale genotype data. HELICS tokenizes chromosomes with convolutional autoencoders, reducing >600K SNPs to 4,096 continuous latent tokens, and trains a transformer parameterized conditional flow matching model over the concatenated multi-chromosome latent representation. Trained on over 417K genomes in the UK Biobank, HELICS generates genome-wide common-variant synthetic cohorts without haplotype phasing and achieves stronger fidelity to real genotypes than existing haplotype-based simulators, including high allele-frequency agreement in external evaluation and superior preservation of local and long-range SNP correlation structure. Conditioning on ancestry and genetic liability summaries enables targeted generation across genetic risk profiles; in perturbation analyses, by increasing the conditioned disease trait liability, HELICS induces SNP-level dosage changes in generated genomes that are highly correlated with published association weights. HELICS provides a scalable generative modeling framework for SNP-level genome data and a path toward conditional synthetic cohorts for data-limited genetic studies.

items.title: Comparative Strategies for Handling Imbalanced QSAR Regression: A Case Study on hERG Activity Prediction
items.title_zh: 处理不平衡 QSAR 回归的比较策略：hERG 活动预测案例研究
items.summary_zh: QSAR 建模中经常出现数据不平衡的情况，但大多数研究都集中在分类任务上，很少涉及回归任务，因为确定数据的哪些区域稀疏或密集具有挑战性。数据级和算法级不平衡处理策略可能对模型性能产生不同的影响。在这项研究中，我们系统地比较了 GCN 和基于指纹的机器学习模型的各种策略。为了更有意义地评估模型性能，我们根据领域知识和数据分布将目标区域划分为多个子区域。我们专注于最有实际利益的领域。我们的结果表明，基于此兴趣区域指标选择模型比使用总区域指标具有更可靠的性能。我们还观察到，不同的不平衡处理策略可能会根据模型类型产生不同的影响。这些发现强调了回归 QSAR 建模中区域感知评估的重要性，并为为不平衡数据集选择适当的策略提供了实用指导。

extra.description: Data imbalance frequently occurs in QSAR modeling, yet most studies focus on classification tasks, and few address regression tasks, as it is challenging to determine which regions of the data are sparse or dense. Data-level and algorithm-level imbalance-handling strategies can have different effects on model performance. In this study, we systematically compare various strategies across GCN and fingerprint-based machine learning models. To evaluate model performance more meaningfully, we partitioned the target region into several subregions based on both domain knowledge and data distribution. We focused on the region of greatest practical interest. Our results demonstrate that selecting models based on this interest-region metric leads to more reliable performance than using the total region metric. We also observed that different imbalance-handling strategies can have divergent effects depending on the model type. These findings highlight the importance of region-aware evaluation in regression QSAR modeling and provide practical guidance for selecting appropriate strategies for imbalanced datasets.

items.title: HistoTx: Early fusion of H&E images and spatial transcriptomics at varying spatial transcriptomics resolution with self-supervised learning
items.title_zh: HistoTx：H&E 图像和空间转录组学在不同空间转录组学分辨率下的早期融合与自我监督学习
items.summary_zh: 空间转录组学绘制了跨组织切片的基因表达图谱，当与整个幻灯片图像集成时，可以共同捕获形态结构和分子活性，以提供丰富的、多模式的组织生物学视图。结合空间转录组学和 WSI 的 ML 方法通常通过病理学基础模型的对比对齐或监督微调来学习从形态特征到分子概况的映射。在这两种情况下，转录组学都是作为训练信号而不是真正的输入模式，使得推理基本上由图像驱动。我们提出了一种早期融合视觉变压器架构，其中以任意空间分辨率构建转录标记，与图像补丁标记合并，并通过共享变压器堆栈联合处理以进行深度跨模式交互。从预训练的仅视觉病理学基础模型开始，我们通过对配对图像和空间转录组数据持续进行自我监督预训练来训练 HistoTx，并证明：1）仅使用图像进行推理时，大多数任务的性能与基线保持一致，同时改进了本质上受益于分子知识的任务，例如基因表达预测； 2）当两种模式均可用于推理时，联合提供图像和转录本输入优于单独使用任何一

extra.description: Spatial transcriptomics maps gene expression across tissue sections and, when integrated with whole slide images, jointly captures both morphological architecture and molecular activity to provide a rich, multimodal view of tissue biology. ML approaches combining spatial transcriptomics and WSIs typically learn a mapping from morphological features to molecular profiles via contrastive alignment or supervised fine-tuning of pathology foundation models. In both cases, transcriptomics serves as a training signal rather than a true input modality, leaving inference fundamentally image-driven. We propose an early-fusion vision transformer architecture in which transcript tokens are constructed at arbitrary spatial resolution, merged with image patch tokens, and jointly processed through a shared transformer stack for deep cross-modal interaction. Starting from a pretrained vision-only pathology foundation model, we train HistoTx by continuing self-supervised pretraining on paired image and spatial transcriptomics data and demonstrate that: 1) at inference with image only, performance remains on par with the baseline on most tasks while improving on tasks that inherently benefit from molecular knowledge, such as gene expression prediction; 2) when both modalities are available at inference, jointly providing image and transcript inputs outperforms either modality alone.

items.title: GraphTFactor: A graph-based approach for proteins transcription factor prediction
items.title_zh: GraphTFactor：一种基于图的蛋白质转录因子预测方法
items.summary_zh: 转录因子（TF）在调控基因表达中发挥重要作用，使其识别成为计算生物学的基本任务。在这项工作中，我们提出GraphTFactor，一种新颖的端到端框架，将蛋白质序列建模为图并直接分类转录因子。通过将序列编码为图结构，所提方法自然处理可变长度输入，同时保留相关关系信息，而不施加长度约束。实验结果表明，GraphTFactor在基准数据集上优于最先进方法，展示了基于图的表示用于TF预测的有效性，同时提供对模型预测贡献序列区域的可解释见解。为支持可重复性和实际采用，我们发布了一个开源软件包和一个交互式网络应用，使用户能够轻松对自定义序列进行TF预测。

extra.description: Transcription factors (TFs) play an important role in regulating gene expression, making their identification a fundamental task in computational biology. In this work, we propose GraphTFactor, a novel end-to-end framework that models protein sequences as graphs and directly classifies transcription factors. By encoding sequences into graph structures, the proposed approach naturally handles variable-length inputs while preserving relevant relational information, without imposing length constraints. Experimental results show that GraphTFactor outperforms state-of-the-art methods on benchmark datasets, demonstrating the effectiveness of graph-based representations for TF prediction while providing interpretable insights into the sequence regions contributing to the model's predictions. To support reproducibility and practical adoption, we release an open-source software package and an interactive web application that let users easily perform TF prediction on custom sequences.

items.title: An autoencoder outperforms two transformers on prediction of gene expression from chromatin accessibility
items.title_zh: 自编码器在从染色质可及性预测基因表达上优于两个 transformer
items.summary_zh: 从染色质可及性预测 RNA 丰度的模型很少在相同特征、目标和指标下比较。我们在来自 19 项人类研究的 126,604 个配对单核图谱上构建了一个基准，共享 50,000 个峰和 3,185 个基因的词表、十个 5x2 交叉验证折和一个评分目标，并在 70 次训练运行中比较了七个已实现流程和两个参考预测器；每个流程保留自己的输入归一化和原生训练目标。基于双变分自编码器的 scButterfly-B 流程在所有六十个配对折比较中，在每基因和细胞内 Spearman 相关上优于所有 transformer 流程，包括自回归 Perceiver 模型（Omic Translator）和无支持重构的 Cisformer，训练时间短 3.8 倍。Transformer 流程在细胞内轮廓形状上差距为 0.02-0.04，但在每基因相关上落后 0.10-0.24。在两个留出细胞类型上每基因相关较低；对照

extra.description: Models that predict RNA abundance from chromatin accessibility are rarely compared under the same features, targets and metrics. We built one benchmark on 126,604 paired single-nucleus profiles from 19 human studies with a shared vocabulary of 50,000 peaks and 3,185 genes, ten 5x2 cross-validation folds and one scoring target, and compared seven implemented pipelines and two reference predictors across 70 trained runs; each pipeline keeps its own input normalisation and native training target. The scButterfly-B pipeline, built on dual variational autoencoders, outperformed every transformer pipeline, including an autoregressive Perceiver model (Omic Translator) and a support-free reformulation of Cisformer, on per-gene and within-cell Spearman correlation in all sixty paired fold comparisons, with 3.8 times shorter training. Transformer pipelines come within 0.02-0.04 on within-cell profile shape but lag by 0.10-0.24 on per-gene correlation. On two withheld cell types per-gene correlation is low; controls show the podocyte values are typical of within-type correlation for seen cell types of the same size, whereas Paneth values match a cell-agnostic shuffle for every Omic Translator arm. Within the transformer family, prespecified ablations show the Perceiver encoder was worth +0.0439 in within-donor per-gene correlation over full self-attention, a chromosome-aware genomic attention prior reduced it by 0.0096 (exact donor-level sign-flip test, Holm-adjusted p = 1.2e-4), and decoder output order had no detectable effect. A training-mean profile reaches 0.314 within-cell correlation with no input and a constant at the true expressed-gene positions reaches 0.996 per-gene correlation, so oracle-support protocols are reported only as diagnostics. Code, results and an audited release are provided.

items.title: OmicsBench: a long-horizon multi-turn benchmark of AI agents on research-study-scale bioinformatics
items.title_zh: OmicsBench：AI智能体在研究级生物信息学上的长时程多轮基准
items.summary_zh: 计算生物学家越来越多地将大量分析委托给AI智能体进行长时程、多轮会话，但大多数智能体生物信息学能力基准只提出单一短任务和单次提示。我们提出OmicsBench，一个面向AI智能体的长时程、多轮生物信息学基准。其97个任务各自将依赖子任务连接成有向无环图，总共662个底层子任务。每个子任务作为一个用户轮次提出，并针对答案键进行确定性评分，对错误答案提供可选的上下文反馈。在三种框架上的12个模型中，最慢的智能体平均每任务耗时3.6小时，没有任何组合接近饱和该基准，无上下文反馈时平均得分为0.43至0.57（满分1），有反馈时为0.54至0.67。多轮评估还揭示了单次提示无法发现的行为，因为智能体在依赖早期子任务的子任务上得分较低，而上下文反馈帮助智能体挽回部分损失。由于确定性评分无法定性说明智能体如何失败，我们还引入了一个无监督失败模式发现流程，用于描述、嵌入和聚类智能体的失败尝试，以揭示涌现

extra.description: Computational biologists increasingly delegate substantial analyses to AI agents in long-horizon, multi-turn sessions, yet most benchmarks of agents' bioinformatics capabilities pose a single short task with a single-shot prompt. We present OmicsBench, a long-horizon, multi-turn bioinformatics benchmark for AI agents. Each of its 97 tasks links dependent subtasks into a directed acyclic graph, for 662 underlying subtasks in all. Each subtask is posed as one user turn and graded deterministically against an answer key, with optional in-context feedback on incorrect answers. Across 12 models on three harnesses, the slowest agent averages 3.6 hours per task, and no combination comes near saturating the benchmark, with mean scores of 0.43 to 0.57 out of a possible 1 without in-context feedback and 0.54 to 0.67 with it. Multi-turn evaluation also uncovers behavior that single-shot prompts cannot, as agents score lower on subtasks that depend on earlier subtasks, and in-context feedback helps agents recover some of that loss. Because deterministic scoring gives no qualitative account of how an agent failed, we also introduce an unsupervised failure mode discovery pipeline that describes, embeds, and clusters agents' failed attempts to surface emergent failure modes. Applied to OmicsBench, this pipeline exposes qualitative shortcomings in how agents carry out bioinformatics analyses, ranging from agents applying their own statistical filters in place of the specified ones to agents writing whole answers from memory.

items.title: Coupling cellular trajectories and RNA kinetics on continuous expression manifolds with ManifoldVelo
items.title_zh: 使用 ManifoldVelo 在连续表达流形上耦合细胞轨迹和 RNA 动力学
items.summary_zh: 从静态单细胞转录组中联合恢复伪时间和 RNA 速度需要协调全局轨迹结构与局部表达变化，特别是在复杂的循环和分支分化中。在这里，我们介绍 ManifoldVelo，一种拓扑条件框架，可共同学习细胞坐标、连续 RNA 轨迹和调节动力学。未剪接和剪接 RNA 轨迹的导数与转录-剪接-降解动力学相匹配，包括观察到的细胞之间的动力学，从而允许表达重建、细胞排序和动力学估计相互告知。 ManifoldVelo 可恢复所有评估的单细胞轨迹类型的伪时间，包括循环、多分支和平滑非分支轨迹。在多峰循环模拟的比较方法中，ManifoldVelo 实现了最佳的伪时间恢复，并且在多峰循环和分支模拟中剪接 RNA 速度的方向一致性最高。真实数据分析支持跨实验板的阶段预测以及与胰腺发育阶段和标记表达一致的分化轨迹。其核心优势是在可重复使用的动态参考中跨不同轨迹结构联合恢复时间位置和局部动态。新细胞仅根据剪接的 RNA

extra.description: Jointly recovering pseudotime and RNA velocity from static single-cell transcriptomes requires reconciling global trajectory structure with local expression changes, particularly in complex cycles and branching differentiation. Here we introduce ManifoldVelo, a topology-conditioned framework that jointly learns cellular coordinates, continuous RNA trajectories and regulatory kinetics. Derivatives of unspliced and spliced RNA trajectories are matched to transcription-splicing-degradation dynamics, including between observed cells, allowing expression reconstruction, cellular ordering and kinetic estimation to inform one another. ManifoldVelo recovers pseudotime across all evaluated single-cell trajectory types, including cyclic, multibranch and smooth non-branching trajectories. ManifoldVelo achieves the best pseudotime recovery among compared methods in multipeak cyclic simulations and the highest directional agreement for spliced RNA velocity in both multipeak cyclic and branching simulations. Real-data analyses support phase prediction across experimental plates and differentiation trajectories consistent with pancreatic developmental stages and marker expression. Its central advantage is the joint recovery of temporal position and local dynamics across distinct trajectory structures within a reusable dynamic reference. New cells are assigned pseudotime and velocity predictions from spliced RNA alone, without refitting the reference model. ManifoldVelo provides a foundation for dynamic cell atlases that transfer learned temporal and kinetic information to new samples.

items.title: Knockdown of the long non-coding RNA DNAAF3-AS1 activates the p53 pathway and remodels the H3K36me3 landscape
items.title_zh: 长链非编码 RNA DNAAF3-AS1 的敲低激活 p53 通路并重塑 H3K36me3 景观
items.summary_zh: 长链非编码 RNA 越来越多地被认为是染色质调节因子，但大多数在功能上仍未得到表征。 DNAAF3-AS1 是纤毛动力蛋白组装因子基因 DNAAF3 的反义转录物，在 HiMoRNA 数据库中几乎完全与 H3K36me3 相关。使用两个独立的反义寡核苷酸敲低 DNAAF3-AS1 后，对人真皮成纤维细胞中的 H3K36me3 ChIP-seq 显示基因体 H3K36me3 显着减少，残余信号转向启动子。在 FANTOM6 CAGE 中，DNAAF3-AS1 敲低激活了 p53 通路，并触发了富含 p53 和凋亡调节因子的基因中启动子的差异使用。一致地，在敲除后获得基因体 H3K36me3 的基因在凋亡相关途径中得到富集。与睾丸中 DNAAF3-AS1 的高表达一致，基于成人睾丸单细胞图谱的分析表明，DNAAF3-AS1 可能有助于精子发生后期启动子水平的 H3K36me3 调节。总之，这些

extra.description: Long non-coding RNAs are increasingly recognised as chromatin regulators, yet most remain functionally uncharacterised. DNAAF3-AS1, transcribed antisense to the ciliary dynein assembly factor gene DNAAF3, is almost exclusively associated with H3K36me3 in the HiMoRNA database. H3K36me3 ChIP-seq in human dermal fibroblasts following DNAAF3-AS1 knockdown with two independent antisense oligonucleotides revealed a marked reduction of gene-body H3K36me3, with residual signal shifted towards promoters. In FANTOM6 CAGE, DNAAF3-AS1 knockdown activated the p53 pathway and triggered differential promoter usage in genes enriched for p53 and apoptotic regulators. Consistently, genes that gained gene-body H3K36me3 upon knockdown were enriched for apoptosis-related pathways. In line with high expression of DNAAF3-AS1 in testis, analysis based on the adult human testis single-cell atlas suggests that DNAAF3-AS1 may contribute to promoter-level H3K36me3 regulation during late spermatogenesis. Together, these results identify DNAAF3-AS1 as a chromatin-associated lncRNA that links H3K36me3 maintenance to p53 signalling.

items.title: BARRR: Bidimensional Augmented Reduced Rank Regression for Multi-View Multi-Cohort Data
items.title_zh: BARRR：用于多视图多队列数据的双向增强降秩回归
items.summary_zh: 跨多个队列（即样本组）和视图（即来源或模态）的双向数据整合在生物医学研究中至关重要，以从异质数据集中获得整体见解。然而，大多数现有整合方法侧重于单一维度，如跨不同来源的多视图整合或跨不同样本组的多队列整合。现有的双向整合方法稀缺且主要无监督，忽视了协变量提供的宝贵见解。为解决这一空白，我们引入双向增强降秩回归（baRRR）方法。我们的方法同时建模协变量相关和不相关效应，同时在两个维度上分解效应水平（全局、部分共享和个体）。大量模拟证明了我们的方法在信号恢复、结果预测和缺失数据插补方面的优势。我们将方法应用于癌症基因组图谱（TCGA）数据，使用体细胞突变作为协变量来告知不同组学平台和癌症类型间的变异模式。这些研究突出了其作为生物医学研究中稳健且适应性强的整合分析工具的潜力。

extra.description: Bidimensional data integration across multiple cohorts (i.e., sample groups) and views (i.e., sources or modalities) is crucial in biomedical research to derive holistic insights from heterogeneous datasets. However, most existing integrative methods focus on a single dimension, such as multi-view integration across distinct sources or multi-cohort integration across distinct sample groups. Existing approaches for bidimensional integration are scarce and predominantly unsupervised, overlooking the valuable insights offered by covariates. To address this gap, we introduce the Bidimensional Augmented Reduced Rank Regression (baRRR) method. Our approach models covariate-related and unrelated effects concurrently, while also decomposing effect levels (global, partially shared, and individual) across both dimensions. Extensive simulations demonstrate the advantages of our method with respect to signal recovery, outcome prediction, and missing data imputation. We apply our approach to data from The Cancer Genome Atlas (TCGA), using somatic mutations as covariates to inform patterns of variability across different omics platforms and cancer types. These studies highlight its potential as a robust and adaptable tool for integrative analysis in biomedical research.

items.title: Reducing double-dipping in single-cell topic models with three-way count splitting
items.title_zh: 用三向计数拆分减少单细胞主题模型中的双重 dipping
items.summary_zh: 主题模型从单细胞RNA测序（scRNA-seq）数据中学习基因程序，然后相同的计数被用于测试哪些基因和供体与这些程序相关。计数拆分是这种复用的标准补救措施，但当编码器读取每个细胞的计数时尚未被测试。在一个104,400细胞的狼疮队列中，每次运行300个置换零基因，朴素检验在名义5%水平下拒绝了36%的零基因-主题对，而通常的两向拆分拒绝了38%，因为编码器看到了被检验基因自身的留出计数。在单独的第三个计数上编码主题使用，使用beta-二项稀疏化，将此降低到7.7%（模型外基因为6.7%）；对于另外两个模型LDVAE和scETM，该率为7.0-7.3%（朴素为51-59%）。一个无标签干扰素程序在狼疮队列和预先指定的COVID-19队列的留出计数中发生偏移，供体水平主题使用预测疾病（AUROC 0.96），超越细胞类型比例（两个队列中分别为0.86和0.58）。校准和预测不依赖于模型。我们不

extra.description: Topic models learn gene programs from single-cell RNA sequencing (scRNA-seq) data, and the same counts are then used to test which genes and donors are associated with those programs. Count splitting is the standard remedy for this reuse, but it has not been tested when an encoder reads each cell's counts. On a 104,400-cell lupus cohort with 300 permuted null genes per run, naive tests rejected 36% of null gene-topic pairs at a nominal 5% level, and the usual two-way split rejected 38%, because the encoder sees the tested gene's own held-out count. Encoding topic usage on a separate third of the counts, with beta-binomial thinning, lowered this to 7.7% (6.7% for genes outside the model); for two other models, LDVAE and scETM, the rate was 7.0-7.3% (naive 51-59%). A label-free interferon program shifts in held-out counts in the lupus cohort and in a pre-specified COVID-19 cohort, and donor-level topic usage predicts disease (AUROC 0.96) beyond cell-type proportions (0.86 and 0.58 in the two cohorts). Calibration and prediction did not depend on the model. We do not claim better clustering, prediction or topic stability. Code, figures and result tables are public (MIT license; DOI 10.5281/zenodo.23307193).

items.title: Understanding Gene Expression-to-Image Learning: Spatial Structure and Information Fidelity
items.title_zh: 理解基因表达到图像学习：空间结构与信息保真度
items.summary_zh: 单细胞RNA测序（scRNA-seq）使生物异质性的细胞水平分析成为可能，但从高维、无序基因表达谱学习有效表示仍具挑战性。基因表达到图像（GE2I）通过将基因值排列在像素网格上供卷积神经网络使用，提供了一种有效学习策略，但其潜在机制仍不清楚。我们在全转录组数据上研究GE2I，同时保持网络和训练过程固定。我们的结果揭示了空间平滑性与基因级保真度之间的权衡。结构化映射产生平滑的低频模式，支持更快的早期优化，而将多个基因分配到同一像素会模糊表达差异并可能降低预测性能。这种权衡解释了为什么当表示许多基因时，随机映射可以与结构化布局竞争。即使图像平滑性降低，一对一基因到像素分配在测试的视觉骨干网络中也能改善预测。我们进一步发现预训练和增强的益处取决于骨干网络和映射。这些发现为像素分配和将视觉先验迁移到基因表达数据提供了实用指导。

extra.description: Single-cell RNA sequencing (scRNA-seq) enables cell-level analysis of biological heterogeneity, but learning effective representations from high-dimensional, unordered gene expression profiles remains challenging. Gene Expression-to-Image (GE2I) offers an effective learning strategy by arranging gene values on pixel grids for convolutional neural networks, but its underlying mechanisms remain unclear. We study GE2I on full-transcriptome data while keeping the network and training procedure fixed. Our results reveal a trade-off between spatial smoothness and gene-level fidelity. Structured mappings produce smooth, low-frequency patterns that support faster early optimization, whereas assigning multiple genes to the same pixel obscures expression differences and can reduce predictive performance. This trade-off explains why random mappings can compete with structured layouts when many genes are represented. One-to-one gene-to-pixel assignment improves prediction across the tested visual backbones even when image smoothness decreases. We further find that the benefits of pretraining and augmentation depend on the backbone and mapping. These findings provide practical guidance for pixel allocation and the transfer of vision priors to gene expression data.

items.title: Protocol for Discovering Convergent Molecular Networks across Multi-Omics Datasets Using Network Propagation
items.title_zh: 使用网络传播跨多组学数据集发现趋同分子网络的方案
items.summary_zh: 表型结果源于分子层之间的协调变化。尽管多组学数据捕捉互补的分子信号，但由于基因水平重叠有限，将其整合为连贯的生物机制仍然具有挑战性。网络传播将每个数据集中的重要基因命中映射到先验知识分子相互作用网络上，并将其信号扩散到邻近基因。对传播网络进行数学整合，随后进行聚类和通路富集，可揭示共享分子网络，从而指出跨正交分子层捕捉到的核心生物学。

extra.description: Phenotypic outcomes arise from coordinated changes across molecular layers. Although multi-omics data capture complementary molecular signals, integrating them into coherent biological mechanisms remains challenging due to limited overlap at the gene level. Network propagation maps significant gene hits from each dataset onto a prior knowledge molecular interaction network and diffuses their signals to neighboring genes. Mathematical integration of propagated networks, followed by clustering and pathway enrichment, reveals shared molecular networks, pinpointing the core biology captured across orthogonal molecular layers.

items.title: WebHarbor: Docking Real Websites for Evolving GUI Agent Environments
items.title_zh: WebHarbor：对接真实网站以适应不断发展的 GUI 代理环境
items.summary_zh: GUI Web 代理需要在评估和培训期间保持稳定的真实交互式环境。实时网站评估受到内容变化、访问限制和经过身份验证的工作流程覆盖范围有限的影响，而现有的培训合成环境通常缺乏功能深度和视觉保真度。我们提出了 WebHarbor，这是一套由 153 个可执行和 Docker 化的网站环境组成的套件，它在确定性控制下忠实地重建了现实世界 Web 服务的可视界面、内容和功能工作流程。我们通过任务驱动的人类代理协作构建 WebHarbor，其中环境随着新任务扩展其功能范围而演变，编码代理实现所需的更改，人类贡献者审核视觉保真度、功能正确性和任务有效性。由此产生的套件包含 3,518 个任务，涵盖多步骤和身份验证后工作流程，而现有工作通常无法涵盖这些工作流程。除了可靠的评估之外，WebHarbor 还为经济高效的强化学习 (RL) 提供高保真合成网络环境。我们证明，在 WebHarbor 中接受 RL

extra.description: GUI web agents require realistic and interactive environments that remain stable during both evaluation and training. Live website evaluation suffers from changing content, access restrictions, and limited coverage of authenticated workflows, while existing synthetic environments for training often lack functional depth and visual fidelity. We propose WebHarbor, a suite of 153 executable and dockerized website environments that faithfully reconstruct the visual interfaces, content, and functional workflows of real-world web services under deterministic control. We build WebHarbor through task-driven human-agent collaboration, where environments evolve as new tasks expand their functional scope, coding agents implement the required changes, and human contributors audit visual fidelity, functional correctness, and task validity. The resulting suite comprises 3,518 tasks spanning multi-step and post-authentication workflows, where existing works often fail to cover. Beyond reliable evaluation, WebHarbor provides high-fidelity synthetic web environments for cost-efficient reinforcement learning (RL). We demonstrate that a Qwen 4B-level GUI agent trained with RL in WebHarbor generalizes to unseen tasks and performs competitively with leading open-source GUI web agents across four benchmarks. The code and data are publicly available at https://github.com/aiming-lab/WebHarbor.

items.title: FADE: Factored Ability--Difficulty Filtering for Online RLVR Scheduling
items.title_zh: FADE：因子能力--在线RLVR调度的难度过滤
items.summary_zh: 具有可验证奖励的基于群体的强化学习（RLVR）仅从采样完成情况不一致的提示中学习：全通过和全失败的群体产生零相对优势并在不改变政策的情况下消耗发电预算。自适应调度程序试图引导推出信息丰富的提示，但它们依赖于每个提示的通过率跟踪器，该跟踪器将两个以截然不同的速度发展的量纠缠在一起——策略在推理技能上的转移能力和每个提示的内在难度。当单个指数平均值或 Beta 计数器同时跟踪两者时，短记忆会打乱提示的相对顺序，而长记忆会报告过时的通过率。我们引入 FADE（分解能力 - 难度估计），这是一种分离两个时间尺度的双线性状态空间滤波器。 FADE 将每个提示的成功 logit 表示为白化 $K$ 维技能加载与快速漂移策略能力向量减去缓慢收缩的标量项目截距的内积。使用 Pólya-Gamma 增强，每个小批量的二进制推出结果通过排名 $K$ Woodbury 步骤以封闭形式更新 $K$ 维能力后验，立

extra.description: Group-based reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) learns only from prompts whose sampled completions disagree: all-pass and all-fail groups produce zero relative advantage and burn generation budget without moving the policy. Adaptive schedulers try to steer rollouts toward informative prompts, yet they rely on per-prompt pass-rate trackers that entangle two quantities evolving at very different speeds---the policy's shifting competence across reasoning skills and each prompt's intrinsic difficulty. When a single exponential average or Beta counter tracks both at once, short memory scrambles the relative ordering of prompts whereas long memory reports stale pass rates. We introduce FADE (Factored Ability--Difficulty Estimation), a bilinear state-space filter that separates the two timescales. FADE represents each prompt's success logit as the inner product of a whitened $K$-dimensional skill loading with a fast-drifting policy ability vector, minus a slow-shrinking scalar item intercept. Using Pólya--Gamma augmentation, each minibatch of binary rollout outcomes updates the $K$-dimensional ability posterior in closed form via a rank-$K$ Woodbury step, instantly transferring competence shifts to all unobserved prompts that share those skills while leaving item intercepts stable. From the resulting posterior mean and variance we derive a closed-form utility for the probability of drawing a non-degenerate rollout group. Across five reasoning benchmarks, two base models, and four scheduling paradigms under a matched rollout budget, FADE consistently improves downstream accuracy and calibration while adding less than $0.6$\,ms per step.

items.title: D&A: Decoupling Description and Assessment Enables VLMs as Zero-Shot Robotic Reward Models
items.title_zh: D&A：解耦描述和评估使 VLM 成为零样本机器人奖励模型
items.summary_zh: 视觉语言模型（VLM）有望在机器人学习中实现零镜头视频任务进度估计，但现有框架经常遭受确认偏差，由于隐含的成功假设或相对时间排名设计而导致失败执行中出现进度幻觉。前沿模型的天真提示会崩溃为二元成功检测器，无法捕获微妙的非线性进展和失败。虽然后训练方法可以通过显式训练来缓解这种情况，但它们需要昂贵的现实世界机器人数据，并且需要对每个单独的基础模型进行计算密集型后训练。为了解决这些限制，我们引入了 D&A（描述和评估）：我们的方法将进度估计解耦为客观的、基于任务的场景动态文本描述，然后是使用明确的评估标准的评估阶段。通过迫使 VLM 在评分之前综合一个明确的、基于文本的绝对成功定义，该框架将评估锚定为外部全局标准，而不是视频的内部时间线。经验结果表明，我们的方法校准了零样本估计并减轻了确认偏差，提供了细粒度的部分进度指标，可以准确地惩罚失败的执行，同时正确地插入成功的运行。 D&A 纯粹基于提

extra.description: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) hold promise for zero-shot video task-progress estimation in robot learning, yet existing frameworks frequently suffer from confirmation bias, hallucinating progress in failed executions due to implicit success assumptions or relative temporal ranking designs. Naive prompting of frontier models collapses into a binary success detector that fails to capture nuanced, non-linear progress and failures. While post-training approaches can mitigate this through explicit training, they demand expensive real-world robotics data and require computationally intensive post-training for every individual base model. To resolve these limitations, we introduce D&A (Describe & Assess): our approach decouples progress estimation into an objective, task-grounded textual description of scene dynamics followed by an assessment phase using explicit rubrics. By compelling the VLM to synthesize an explicit, text-based definition of absolute success before scoring, the framework anchors evaluations to an external, global criterion rather than the video's internal timeline. Empirical results demonstrate that our method calibrates zero-shot estimates and mitigates confirmation bias, providing fine-grained, partial progress metrics that accurately penalize failed executions while correctly interpolating successful runs. Being purely prompt-based, D&A generalizes across tasks, embodiments, and benchmarks---matching or surpassing post-trained reward models---and its reward estimates enable efficient downstream reinforcement learning.

items.title: Strategist: Evolving Reasoning with Agents
items.title_zh: 策略师：与智能体一起进化推理
items.summary_zh: 模型只是人工智能代理系统的一半。另一半是推理策略：将模型调用转化为响应的推理过程。如今，后半部分是手写的，制定一个策略的经验永远不会延续到下一个策略。我们引入了 Strategist，一种可以跨任务发展推理策略的元代理。每个策略都被编写为蓝图，其他策略可以重用的可执行代码，并且蓝图一起形成一个库。给定一项任务和一个小型开发集，策略师检索相关蓝图，编写候选策略，在真实样本上进行测试，并根据结果进行修改。然后每个候选人都会进入图书馆，因此后续任务会建立在早期发现的基础上。在 30 个基准测试中，Strategist 在 24 个基准测试中击败了最强基准，并与其平均准确度（74.7% 对比 74.0%）相匹配，但推理成本降低了 39%。它的策略也可以转移到看不见的任务和其他模型，而无需进一步搜索。人工智能系统中原本无法自行改进的部分现在已经可以改进了。

extra.description: A model is only half of an AI agent system. The other half is the inference strategy: the reasoning procedure that turns model calls into a response. Today that second half is written by hand, and the experience of building one strategy never carries to the next. We introduce Strategist, a meta-agent that evolves inference strategies across tasks. Each strategy is written as a blueprint,executable code that other strategies can reuse, and together the blueprints form a library. Given a task and a small development set, Strategist retrieves related blueprints, writes candidate strategies, tests them on real samples, and revises them from the results. Every candidate then enters the library, so later tasks build on earlier discoveries. On 30 benchmarks, Strategist beats the strongest baseline on 24 and matches its average accuracy (74.7% vs.74.0%) at 39% lower inference cost. Its strategies also transfer to unseen tasks and other models without further search. The part of an AI system that is not improved on its own now does.

items.title: Benchmark Prediction with Sparse and Unpaired Cached Responses
items.title_zh: 使用稀疏且不成对的缓存响应进行基准预测
items.summary_zh: 对来自所有可用基准任务的所有查询评估生成模型的成本极其昂贵。因此，模型通常在不同的任务子集和/或来自给定任务的不同查询子集上进行评估。得到的响应集合和相应的（模型、任务）得分矩阵是稀疏且不配对的。在本文中，我们介绍了产品核透视空间（PKPS），它是基于嵌入响应的模型低维表示的集合。 PKPS 通过比较对相似（而不仅仅是相同）查询的响应，概括了表示黑盒生成模型的现有方法，因此能够利用稀疏和不配对的信息。从理论上讲，我们表明，相对于仅使用来自评估数据的密集和成对部分的信息的方法，使用 PKPS 的基准预测具有查询效率。根据经验，我们表明基于 PKPS 的方法在两个大型基准套件中的基准预测方面优于基线。

extra.description: Evaluating a generative model on all queries from all available benchmark tasks is prohibitively expensive. As such, models are often evaluated on different subsets of tasks and/or different subsets of queries from a given task. The resulting collection of responses and the corresponding (model, task) score matrix are sparse and unpaired. In this paper, we introduce the Product Kernel Perspective Space (PKPS), a collection of low-dimensional representations of models based on their embedded responses. PKPS generalizes existing methods for representing black-box generative models by comparing responses to similar -- rather than just identical -- queries and is therefore able to utilize sparse and unpaired information. Theoretically, we show that benchmark prediction using PKPS is query-efficient relative to methods that only use information from dense and paired portions of the evaluation data. Empirically, we show that PKPS-based methods outperform baselines on benchmark prediction across two large benchmark suites.

items.title: VoroTIDE: Protein domain segmentation through independent hierarchical searches using Voronoi tessellation and physical self-containment
items.title_zh: VoroTIDE：使用 Voronoi 镶嵌和物理自包含通过独立分层搜索进行蛋白质域分割
items.summary_zh: 蛋白质结构域通常被认为是结构上分离的、功能上相关的和进化上可分离的单元。尽管分类系统可以将不同的域边界分配给相同的结构，但结构分离仍然是一个共享标准，并且许多域解析器通过残基间距离、联系数量或联系密度来评估它。然而，广泛用于研究蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用和预测接触位点的 Voronoi 接触区域在域解析中的用途有限。这个问题有两个潜在的挑战。首先，与蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用不同，分区是事先未知的，必须在评估其界面之前进行识别。其次，接触面积取决于碎片大小和内部包装，使得比较候选分区变得困难。在这里，我们介绍VoroTIDE（基于Voronoi的双向独立域探索），一个基于全重原子Voronoi接触区域的域解析器。通过标准化片段大小和内部堆积的接触面积，并结合残基亲水性，我们定义了成对的自包含分数 F。VoroTIDE 在两个独立的分层搜索中应用 F：自上而下的递归分裂，直到没有允许的分裂，以及二级

extra.description: Protein domains are commonly regarded as structurally separated, functionally relevant, and evolutionarily separable units. Although classification systems may assign different domain boundaries to the same structure, structural separation remains a shared criterion, and many domain parsers assess it through inter-residue distances, contact numbers, or contact densities. However, the Voronoi contact area, which is widely used to study protein-protein interactions and predict contact sites, has seen limited use in domain parsing. There are two potential challenges to this problem. First, unlike in protein-protein interaction, partitions are not known in advance and must be identified before their interface can be evaluated. Second, the contact area depends on fragment size and internal packing, making it difficult to compare candidate partitions. Here, we introduce VoroTIDE (Voronoi-based Two-way Independent Domain Exploration), a domain parser based on all-heavy-atom Voronoi contact areas. By normalizing the contact area for fragment size and internal packing, and incorporating residue hydropathy, we define a pairwise self-containment score F. VoroTIDE applies F in two independent hierarchical searches: top-down recursive splitting until no admissible division remains, and bottom-up merging of secondary-structure elements until the entire structure becomes a single fragment. Intermediate partitions from both searches are ranked by a global partition quality score G, derived on the same principle. On two CATH-ECOD consensus benchmarks, under balanced evaluation, VoroTIDE achieved the strongest performance among all tested criterion-based parsers and was comparable to Chainsaw, the best-performing deep learning method tested. These results show that the Voronoi-based criterion can yield competitive domain parsing.

items.title: Comparative analysis of protease-inhibitor gene family counts under different counting units and genome annotations
items.title_zh: 不同计数单位下蛋白酶抑制剂基因家族计数对比分析及基因组注释
items.summary_zh: 背景：基因家族大小通常使用随基因组组装释放的蛋白质组进行跨物种比较。然而，当注释每个基因包含多个条目并且基因组由不同的管道注释时，域阳性蛋白质条目的计数可能与基因的计数不同。在这项研究中，我们测量了这两个因素如何改变蛋白酶抑制剂结构域家族的计数。结果：在八个动物基因组中计数了七个蛋白酶抑制剂家族。将蛋白质条目折叠到基因中，使 48 个物种科组合中的 36 个物种的计数减少了 4.6 倍（埃及伊蚊中的 Kunitz/BPTI，5 个基因中的 23 个条目），并在 196 个配对比较中的 9 个中颠倒了两个物种的顺序。在具有多个正条目的 223 个基因家族记录中的 218 个中，所有条目与代表性条目共享 CDS 坐标。同一水蛭（Hirudinaria manillensis）组装的两个注释在科特有的方式上有所不同。在已发表的注释中，50 个 Antistasin 阳性基因中的 38 个和两个水

extra.description: Background: Gene family sizes are often compared across species using the protein sets released with genome assemblies. However, counts of domain-positive protein entries can differ from counts of genes when an annotation contains several entries per gene, and genomes are annotated by different pipelines. In this study, we measured how these two factors change the counts of protease-inhibitor domain families. Results: Seven protease-inhibitor families were counted in eight animal genomes. Collapsing protein entries to genes reduced the counts in 36 of 48 species-family combinations, by up to 4.6-fold (Kunitz/BPTI in Aedes aegypti, 23 entries in 5 genes), and reversed the order of two species in 9 of 196 pairwise comparisons. In 218 of 223 gene-family records with several positive entries, all entries shared CDS coordinates with the representative entry. Two annotations of the same leech (Hirudinaria manillensis) assembly differed in a family-specific way. In the published annotation, 38 of 50 Antistasin-positive genes and both Hirudin-positive genes had no same-strand gene model in a second annotation, whereas most Kunitz/BPTI, Serpin, TIL and Thyroglobulin genes had one-to-one partners. A search of the eight assemblies without gene models detected all 338 annotated Kunitz/BPTI-positive genes when the queries included proteins of the same species. Queries from other species recovered only 31-83% of these genes, and Kunitz-like candidate regions outside the annotations were most numerous in the tick Ixodes scapularis. For the mosquito and the tick, the second public annotations shared nearly all gene-model coordinates with RefSeq and were therefore excluded from the comparison of annotation sources. Conclusions: These results indicate that gene family counts depend on the counting unit and on the annotation source. Comparisons across species should count each gene once and state how domain positivity was assigned to genes. In addition, the source and version of each annotation should be reported, the annotations should be checked against the genome assembly, and the overlap of gene models should be examined before two annotations are compared.

items.title_zh: 如何看待新华社公众号在11月2日发表的文章《国乒男队怎么了？》中表示：男子乒坛多极格局已成?
items.summary_zh: 北京时间11月2日凌晨，2026年世界乒乓球职业大联盟（WTT）蒙彼利埃冠军赛收官，韩国选手张禹珍首度斩获WTT冠军赛男单冠军，这也是韩国乒乓球队史上首座WTT冠军赛级别单打桂冠。遗憾的是，本届赛事，中国男乒五人参赛、三人进八强后止步，无人跻身半决赛，这与女队包揽前四形成鲜明对比。人们不禁要问：国乒男队怎么了？ 赛场亮点需肯定 需要明确的是，蒙彼利埃冠军赛仅是一项WTT分站赛事，不足以据此判定国乒男队失去项目优势。但把它放进2026年的WTT赛事脉络中，对照外协会选手的关键分能力，仍可窥一斑而见全豹。 梳理今年WTT高级别赛事战绩，国乒男单仅在新加坡大满贯赛由王楚钦斩获一冠。其余赛事的冠军均是外协会选手：多哈冠军赛，中国台北队选手林昀儒夺魁；重庆冠军赛，法国队的小勒布伦登顶；美国大满贯赛，日本队松岛辉空折桂；横滨冠军赛，日本队张本智和问鼎；瑞典大满贯赛，小勒布伦夺冠；中国大满贯赛，松岛辉空

items.title: 伊朗最高领袖赋予政府谈判权限，若美落实诉求，两天内可以开谈，国际油价大跌6%，美伊谈判还有哪些变数？
items.title_zh: 伊朗最高领袖赋予政府谈判权限，若美落实诉求，两天内可以开谈，国际油价大跌6%，美伊谈判还有哪些变数？
items.summary_zh: 据CCTV国际时讯，伊朗总统佩泽希齐扬今天（11月2日）强调，敌人无法通过战争让伊朗投降，“我们将坚决抵制他们的谎言和夸大其词，因此我们必须努力增强人民的韧性，解决他们的关切和担忧。”他表示，伊朗政府的目标是更好地照顾弱势群体。 佩泽希齐扬指出，必须在伊朗人民的支持与合作下，克服敌人给伊朗造成的挑战和危机。伊朗政府正在努力通过对话解决问题，在这方面，伊朗最高领袖穆杰塔巴·哈梅内伊也赋予了政府一定的权限。 据新华社，伊朗外交部发言人巴加埃2日表示，如果美国同意落实伊朗诉求，相关方案最快可在两天内启动，霍尔木兹海峡安全将得到恢复，伊美谈判进程也将随之启动。 巴加埃说，伊朗和美国通过中间方开展任何间接接触，都将以伊朗提出的“七日计划”为基础。伊朗“本着善意压缩方案实施时间”，方案能否实现“取决于美国的意愿和决定”。 受上述消息影响，国际油价跳水，截至发稿，WTI原油、布伦特原油日内跌幅近6%。

items.title: 保时捷女销冠再夺第一，所属公司却半年亏 2.7 亿，个人业绩拉满、公司疯狂失血，传统豪华车市场怎么了？
items.title_zh: 保时捷女销冠再夺第一，所属公司却半年亏 2.7 亿，个人业绩拉满、公司疯狂失血，传统豪华车市场怎么了？
items.summary_zh: 11月1日，青岛保时捷中心知名销售顾问牟倩文个人社交账号发布的信息显示，截至10月31日，她再次拿到品牌全国销售排名榜首，销量、销售积分双双位列全国第一，但其所属的美东汽车却半年净亏2.75亿元。 这位35岁的销售已经连续三年拿下青岛保时捷中心年度销冠，2023、2024年都卖出170台，2025年销量上涨至192台，2026年10月单月就拿下16台订单，守住全国第一的位次。 据红星新闻报道，过去十个月里，牟倩文一直在朝着登上榜首的目标努力。“过程里也曾被同事赶超，也感到压力，但我始终守住自己的节奏，凭着一股劲儿，向着目标坚持，最终拿到这份销售成绩。”牟倩文说。 界面新闻注意到，早在去年1月，她曾谈及走红之后的心态。她说很看淡自己上热搜、上头条的事情，没有觉得能让她能怎么样，自己还是那个卖车的Molly，还是一个3岁孩子的妈妈，没有把自己放到很高的位置。 但她也强调自己是一个洞察力非常强的

items.title: 《影之刃零》Steam简体中文区好评率从77%一路走高，发售四天后上升为90%，如何评价这一成绩？
items.title_zh: 《影之刃零》Steam简体中文区好评率从77%一路走高，发售四天后上升为90%，如何评价这一成绩？
items.summary_zh: 《影之刃零》10 月 29 日解锁后，Steam 简体中文区的评价并不好看：当天下午好评率 77%，评级停在「多半好评」。部分玩家遇到着色器编译卡死、启动崩溃的问题，进不去游戏的人不在少数。也有玩家认为游戏粗糙，战斗系统摸不着头脑。 但这条曲线没有停在那里。随着越来越多的玩家真正玩进去，游戏时间从几小时拉到几十小时，评价开始反转：硬核爽快的战斗、武侠味道的美术、越往后越扎实的内容，成了评论里反复出现的词。好评率也一路走高，目前已经达到 90%。 从「多半好评」到「特别好评」，几天时间，同一款游戏。你怎么看这次反转？

items.title: 如何解读2026年10月汽车销量榜：比亚迪近49万稳居第一，小米、小鹏齐破5万，鸿蒙智行同比却腰斩？
items.title_zh: 如何解读2026年10月汽车销量榜：比亚迪近49万稳居第一，小米、小鹏齐破5万，鸿蒙智行同比却腰斩？
items.summary_zh: 来源：2026 年 10 月汽车销量 / 交付榜出炉：比亚迪超 49 万辆稳居榜首，小米月销重回 5 万辆 根据 IT之家汇总的 2026 年 10 月车企销量、交付榜单，比亚迪以 490168 辆继续稳居榜首，同比、环比双双上涨，体量优势明显。小米汽车交付量超过 5 万辆，重回5万梯队；同期小鹏创下历史新高，零跑连续四个月稳定突破十万。与之形成对比，鸿蒙智行本月交付 33537 辆，出现明显下滑，同比接近腰斩，虽然它全系成交均价仍超过四十万。 同样是新能源赛道，为什么走量品牌持续冲高，而主打高端路线的鸿蒙智行出现大幅回落？这种分化，是短期产品周期、上新空档带来的波动，还是市场选择正在发生长期变化？高端智驾路线如果销量持续下滑，对后续产品规划、定价策略又会带来哪些影响？ （注：部分为销量、部分为交付，统计口径不完全一致，数据仅供参考）

items.title: 2026 年美国中期选举，共和党与民主党谁能最终获胜？
items.title_zh: 2026 年美国中期选举，共和党与民主党谁能最终获胜？
items.summary_zh: 美国中期选举将于11月3日举行，民主党和共和党将角逐国会众议院全部435个议席和参议院100个议席中的35个。此外，美国多个州将选举州长、州议员及部分地方官员。
